development_adaptation_disclosure: The exact final selection/refit rule was formalized after the first broad fold and contrast results from the second fold had been inspected, before the remaining broad-fold fits and before any reserved Siraj chromosome prediction. It is a development decision, not a fully preregistered analysis.
candidate_set: All nine fixed families in the three-fold development plan. Neural candidates use the fixed three-seed mean; no individual-seed cherry-picking. Classical settings selected by earlier4–5 screening are retained.

selection_rule.overall_assay_call_detector: Highest unweighted mean of three fold macro(two studies)normalized APskill
selection_rule.within_active_variant_ranker: Highest unweighted mean of three fold macro(two studies)conditional-active normalized APskill; contrast uses active expert, other models use overall score within active evaluation rows
selection_rule.tie_rule: Only exact floating-point ties use lexical family name; no performance threshold is silently introduced

refit_rule.data: All eligible development chromosomes4–22; no reserved1–3 fitting or early stopping
refit_rule.epochs: For each selected family and seed, round the median of its three development-fold best epochs to nearest positive integer (half rounded upward). Keep the original optimizer, transforms, targets and loss weights. No new stopping decision on reserved data.
refit_rule.classical: Clone the prespecified screening-selected estimator, fit all imputation/scaling/weights on development4–22, with training class weights recomputed
refit_rule.ensemble: Arithmetic mean over fixed neural seeds; retain both task models if selected families differ

final_evaluation: After checkpoint replay and raw-input validation, write selection/artifact SHA256 manifest and explicitly gated once-only evaluation. Show both selected roles, fullAVI-only, sequence-pattern and physical-chromatin comparators. Prior Salomon study performance is reused study evidence; Siraj fixed-library chromosomes are the reserved study result. No test-driven reselection or redesign.
uncertainty: Report per-study AUROC/AP and base rates, conditional-active scores separately; paired1Mb genomic block bootstrap with fixed1000replicates, plus5Mb500-replicate sensitivity. These express within-assay sampling uncertainty, not independent donors or clinical generalization.
evaluation_scope: Molecular assay effect/detection calls, not sleep/frailty disease prediction, causal genes, PRS validation or genetic correlation.

matched_neural_ablation_refits.purpose: Paired final comparison of AlphaGenome inputs/auxiliary targets against matching no-AVI neural families. These comparisons are scientifically necessary for attribution; model role selection remains based only on completed development folds.
matched_neural_ablation_refits.fit_rule: Refit all five already-prespecified development families with the same median-per-seed fixed epoch rule and all development data. No new architecture, task, target, hyperparameter search or reserved-test selection.
matched_neural_ablation_refits.post_evaluation_constraint: Report matched differences without changing the preselected primary model on test performance.
matched_neural_ablation_refits.disclosure: Added after most development results were available and before any final recipe lock, refit or reserved evaluation. This is not a fully preregistered study.

conditional_combination_extension.reason: Development evidence shows complementary DNA-expert andAVI errors in all6study/fold checks. Test3fixed conditional combination candidates before role selection.
conditional_combination_extension.selection_rule: Same mean across3folds/two studies. Add all3combination candidates as final controls; no reserved-test selection.
conditional_combination_extension.nested_CV_qualification: Explicitly a development comparison. Base-fold stopping and overlapping other-fold fitting mean combination cross-validation is not an unbiased nested-CV estimate. The untouched reserved evaluation remains necessary.
conditional_combination_extension.final_coefficients: Learn from all measured-active development rows with saved held-fold base scores and training-fitted quantile references. Deployment uses the refitted base ensemble; evaluate possible distribution/calibration shift honestly.
